purpose: Canonical product and infrastructure protocol posture for the capability-first reorganization. It separates public product contracts, internal service RPC, transport security, serialization, telemetry, provider-owned fabric, and benchmark-gated future profiles.

selection_rules.sse: server-to-client streams where browser-native reconnect and event ids are sufficient
selection_rules.websocket: bidirectional sessions only; AsyncAPI describes messages without claiming a stable CloudEvents WebSocket binding

compatibility: reserve removed field names and numbers
run wire-compatibility checks independently from semantic compatibility checks

future_profile.name: protobuf-editions-2024
future_profile.activation: separate Accepted compatibility profile after prost/tonic and cross-language generator qualification

transport_security.exceptions: loopback, Unix sockets, or provider-owned equivalent protection require an explicit reviewed profile; no silent downgrade

activation_requires: no second independently authored source of truth

telemetry.application_semantics: OpenTelemetry instrumentation remains mandatory for tenant, workflow, authorization, and business semantics

fabric.activation_boundary: a separate Accepted profile must prove Oyatie owns the relevant device or bare-metal fabric and has interoperability, congestion, loss, telemetry, rollback, and operator evidence

non_claims: This contract does not claim every allowed protocol is implemented by every capability.
This contract does not claim public gRPC, gRPC-Web, Connect, or GraphQL compatibility.
This contract does not claim an owned physical Clos/EVPN fabric, switch NOS, SAI integration, gNMI/gNOI actuation, UEC, RoCEv2, or NVMe/RDMA deployment.
This contract does not make HTTP/3 availability a correctness dependency.
This contract does not claim that eBPF can replace application-level telemetry.
